metadata.name: NOMAD Central Platform
metadata.description: NOMAD Central Platform is a free web service that allows you to share your data or use comprehensive data provided by others. You can use NOMAD Central to organize, analyze, share, and publish your materials science data, as well as explore, download, and analyze the data of your colleagues. NOMAD is not only about sharing files, it is about sharing data and making them FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable). All data in NOMAD are organized in well-defined structures described by a formal schema. When you publish a project, you can assign it a Digital Object Identifier (DOI) so others can cite it.

data_curation.notes: NOMAD provides tools and workflows to support high-quality and FAIR research data, including schema-based storage, automatic metadata extraction and validation. However, the responsibility for the scientific accuracy and completeness of published data remains with the data providers.  Some datasets and collections may undergo additional curation by research groups or community initiatives, but NOMAD itself does not perform scientific peer review of all submitted data.

data_access_condition.notes: Public data in NOMAD Central can be searched, viewed, and downloaded free of charge without signing in. For projects published under embargo, entry metadata remain publicly visible, while access to the files is limited to authorized users until the embargo expires or is lifted.

data_deposition_condition.notes: Researchers can deposit materials science data by creating a free NOMAD Central account or by signing in via Helmholtz AAI with a participating identity provider. A project must contain at least one successfully processed entry before it can be published.
